pages.text: Look for large stepped limestone silhouettes in the plains, dunes, woods, or dead oases. A $(l:atum:people/villagers)Cartographer$(/l) can help you find one with a Pyramid Explorer Map. Entering earns Pyramid Scheme.

Before its guardian is defeated, a pyramid protects its blocks and restricts what you can place inside. Bring torches, food, a shield, and healing. Mark branches, watch for spawners, and treat unlit corridors as dangerous.

Look for matching carved blocks and torch sockets. $(l:atum:exploration/traps)Traps and Hidden Doors$(/l) explains the mechanisms. Ready for the central chamber? Open $(l:atum:divine/pharaoh_ritual)the optional ritual walkthrough$(/l).
